```powershell
Write-Output '=== FIX 505 - THE TERMINAL ANSWERS ITSELF ONCE (Ground: the photo shows the fault plain - he pressed attach while the terminal itself stood in front, and the terminal printed its own answer in a loop, the same line stacked down the pane. The message is true once and noise the fifth time. This job reads the terminal source at the exact addresses first - the self line and its surroundings, the attach function whole - then applies a throttle at that one print: the self notice may speak at most once in five seconds, so a burst of attach calls reads as one answer. The patch is shape gated: if the print statement does not stand in the expected single call form, nothing is written and the printed regions author the next job. On a clean patch the job closes the running terminal, compiles the new exe with the standing compiler line, relaunches it, and prints the log tail so the fixed build standing is proven in its own words. If the compile fails, the old exe is relaunched untouched and the failure lines print. Every variable carries the p505 prefix.) ==='
$p505b64 = ''
$p505py = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'patch505.py'
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($p505py, [Convert]::FromBase64String($p505b64))
$p505exe = 'C:\Users\Admin\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps\python.exe'
$p505out = & $p505exe $p505py
$p505out | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_ }
$p505dir = 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal'
$p505bin = Join-Path $p505dir 'PhiTerminal.exe'
if (($p505out -join ' ') -match 'PATCH OK') {
  Get-Process -Name 'PhiTerminal' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
  $p505csc = 'C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe'
  $p505cs = Join-Path $p505dir 'PhiTerminal3.cs'
  $p505cout = & $p505csc /target:winexe /out:$p505bin /reference:System.Windows.Forms.dll /reference:System.Drawing.dll $p505cs 2>&1
  $p505cout | Select-Object -Last 6 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('CSC ' + $_) }
  Write-Output ('EXE bytes=' + (Get-Item $p505bin).Length + ' written=' + (Get-Item $p505bin).LastWriteTime)
  Start-Process -FilePath $p505bin -WorkingDirectory $p505dir
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
  $p505log = Join-Path $p505dir 'phi_terminal_universal.log'
  if (Test-Path $p505log) { Get-Content $p505log -Tail 6 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('NEWTAIL ' + $_) } }
  Write-Output 'PHI P505 VERDICT: FIXED BUILD STANDING'
} else {
  Write-Output 'PHI P505 VERDICT: PATCH HELD - REGIONS PRINTED ABOVE'
}
Write-Output 'JOB 505 DONE'
```
